Header.value: 1. Naturalness: does the voice sound like a real person speaking?

Choice.hint: Severe distortion or garbling; barely sounds like speech.
Strong artifacts or robotic throughout; tiring to listen to.
Clearly synthetic (metallic, buzzy, flat), but easy to follow.
Small artifacts or slightly odd rhythm, noticeable only when listening closely.
Sounds like a real person speaking; no artifacts.

Header.value: 2. Intelligibility: does the audio say exactly the reference text, word for word?

Choice.hint: Most of the text missing or wrong, a different sentence or language, or unintelligible.
Several words wrong or missing, or part of the sentence cut off.
One word wrong, missing, added, or mispronounced so it changes or hides the meaning.
A word slightly mispronounced, but the meaning is clear.
